description: Mesa native independent Marker4 V7 drawable compositing control, coincident turn-9.5 saved geometry, scale 1 and phase 0. Each stroke constructs and uploads independent native drawable and point buffers. RGBA8 is premultiplied; background hex is RGBA. Patch is applied to mesa_capture.py; draw-count 1 or 2 selects stroke count.
source_over: round(source + destination * (1 - source alpha / 255)) per channel
comparison: all 2097152 RGBA channel bytes exactly match source-over for AB, BA, A on opaque background, and B on A over opaque background; AB and BA differ at 819 channel bytes.
scope: single saved geometry and host Mesa GLES setup; not Android device or full application rendering parity

compact_fixture.layout: 282 records in native frame scan order; 6 RGBA8 pixels per record: A, B, AB, BA, background AB, background A; retain pixels with A or B alpha nonzero

reproduce.setup: From project root: cp tools/marker4_v7/mesa_capture.py /tmp/m4-independent.py; patch /tmp/m4-independent.py < tools/marker4_v7/independent-colors.patch. Use a fresh output directory and the PYTHONPATH/dependencies described in mesa_capture.py; native helper files and DSOs under tmp/vector-parity-plan are temporary project-local dependencies.
reproduce.output: Pass --capture-output <directory>/m4-independent-<name>.json for each capture. Run python3 tools/marker4_v7/extract_independent_colors.py <directory> <new-output-path> to verify frame hashes and regenerate the compact fixture.

full_frames: Original full frames were temporary and are not retained; their hashes identify the measured inputs and can be checked by recapture and the extraction script. Capture JSON receipts also were temporary; their old hashes are omitted because their path-dependent content is not retained.
regression_dependency: crates/sdocx/tests/marker4_host_compositing.rs checks the compact captured pixels against shared host arithmetic in crates/sdocx/src/ink/host_rgba8.rs. The crate-local fixture at crates/sdocx/tests/assets/marker4-independent-colors.rgba is byte-identical to compact_fixture.path and is included in the published crate.
